prompt:

output.program:
domain(person,[vincent,hugh]).
% Vincent is trustworthy or has expertise.
axiom(s1,or(trustworthy(vincent),has_expertise(vincent))).
% Vincent examines evidence or thinks critically (or both).
axiom(s2,or(examines_evidence(vincent),thinks_critically(vincent))).

axiom(s4,implies(has_expertise(vincent),and(works_diligently(vincent),solves_complex_cases(vincent)))).
% Vincent has keen insight.
axiom(s5,keen_insight(vincent)).
% Anyone who evaluates clues or makes connections can think critically.
axiom(s6,forall(X,implies(or(evaluates_clues(X),makes_connections(X)),thinks_critically(X)))).

axiom(s7,forall(X,implies(keen_insight(X),and(analyzes_data(X),understands_motives(X))))).

axiom(s8,implies(follows_clues(vincent),uncovers_truth(vincent))).

axiom(s9,implies(investigates_crime(vincent),xor(examines_evidence(vincent),analyzes_data(vincent)))).
% Vincent investigates crime.
axiom(s10,investigates_crime(vincent)).
% If someone solves complex cases and thinks critically, then they can uncover the truth.
axiom(s11,forall(X,implies(and(solves_complex_cases(X),thinks_critically(X)),uncovers_truth(X)))).

% If someone uncovers the truth, then they can find justice.
axiom(s14,forall(X,implies(uncovers_truth(X),find_justice(X)))).
% Vincent values integrity or is trustworthy.
axiom(s15,or(values_integrity(vincent),trustworthy(vincent))).

axiom(s16,implies(reliable(vincent),xor(has_expertise(vincent),has_experience(vincent)))).
